proposals.before: On the first day of the first month of spring in the sixth year of Xiansi, dingwei, the Emperor held audience in Chongyuan Hall to receive the New Year's felicitations, with the ceremonial guard arrayed according to regulation.
proposals.after: On the first day of the first month of spring in the sixth year of Xiande, dingwei, the Emperor held audience in Chongyuan Hall to receive the New Year's felicitations, with the ceremonial guard arrayed according to regulation.
proposals.reason: 顯德 is the Later Zhou reign-title Xiande, not Xiansi.

decisions.reason: Focus unit opens 顯德六年; 顯德 is the Later Zhou reign title Xiande. Xiansi is a false romanization, and replacing it with Xiande corrects the error without other wording changes.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 顯德六年春正月丁未朔

decisions.reason: The annotation cites 顯德六年; that reign title is Xiande, not Xiansi. The proposed swap fixes only the romanization and leaves the rest of the note intact.
Focus unit has 澶州節度使; 澶州 is Chanzhou. Cangzhou would be 滄州, which the chapter uses separately (e.g. the halt at 滄州 before the northern campaign). The replacement corrects only that place name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 時張永德為澶州節度使

decisions.reason: Focus unit begins 澶州節度使兼殿前都點檢; 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Cangzhou (滄州). The proposed wording restores the correct prefecture and preserves the rest of the sentence.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 澶州節度使兼殿前都點檢、駙馬都尉張永德

decisions.reason: Focus unit places Zhang Mei as 澶州糧料使 and Shizong as 鎮澶州; both are Chanzhou. Rendering them as Cangzhou confuses 澶州 with 滄州; the proposal’s Chanzhou fix matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 美少為三司小吏、澶州糧料使，世宗鎮澶州

decisions.reason: Focus unit recalls 澶州所為; that place is Chanzhou, not Cangzhou. The single place-name correction aligns the English with the Chinese.
Focus unit has 今澶、汴相去甚邇; 澶 is Chanzhou (cf. 澶州節度使 / 澶淵 in the surrounding units), not Cangzhou. ‘Chan and Bian’ correctly shortens that pair in the same style as the faulty ‘Cang and Bian’.

Focus unit has only 偽寧州刺史, with no Northern Han label. The surrounding northern campaign (from 滄州 to 乾寧軍, then 益津關 and 瓦橋關) is the Liao/Khitan frontier drive of 959, so ‘Northern Han-appointed’ invents the wrong polity; ‘Liao-appointed’ restores the correct affiliation for this 偽 officer.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 至乾寧軍，偽寧州刺史王洪以城降

decisions.reason: Focus unit has 偽守將姚內斌 at 瓦橋關, again without a Northern Han label. Waqiao Pass belongs to the same Liao/Khitan Three Passes frontier as the rest of this northern campaign; ‘Northern Han garrison commander’ invents the wrong side, and ‘Khitan garrison commander’ corrects it.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 今上先至瓦橋關，偽守將姚內斌以城降
